anime_catalog.title: Your Name – Hindi Dub
anime_catalog.description: Two teenagers mysteriously swap bodies and form a connection across time and space in this beautiful animated film. As they navigate this supernatural phenomenon, they must find each other before a catastrophic event separates them forever.

anime_catalog.title: Spirited Away – Hindi Dub
anime_catalog.description: A young girl enters a magical world ruled by a witch and must work to free herself and her parents. This Academy Award-winning film follows Chihiro's journey through a spirit world filled with strange creatures and magical transformations.

anime_catalog.title: My Neighbor Totoro – Hindi Dub
anime_catalog.description: Two sisters discover magical forest spirits near their new home in the countryside. This heartwarming tale follows Satsuki and Mei as they befriend the gentle giant Totoro and other forest creatures.

anime_catalog.title: Princess Mononoke – Hindi Dub
anime_catalog.description: A young warrior becomes involved in a struggle between forest gods and humans. This epic tale explores themes of environmentalism and the conflict between nature and civilization.

anime_catalog.title: Howl's Moving Castle – Hindi Dub
anime_catalog.description: A young woman is cursed by a witch and seeks help from a wizard living in a magical moving castle. This enchanting story follows Sophie's transformation and her relationship with the mysterious Howl.

anime_catalog.title: Kiki's Delivery Service – Hindi Dub
anime_catalog.description: A young witch moves to a new town and starts a delivery service using her flying abilities. This coming-of-age story follows Kiki as she learns independence and finds her place in the world.

anime_catalog.title: Castle in the Sky – Hindi Dub
anime_catalog.description: A young girl and boy search for a legendary floating castle in the sky. This adventure follows Sheeta and Pazu as they evade pirates and government agents while seeking the mysterious Laputa.

anime_catalog.title: The Tale of Princess Kaguya – Hindi Dub
anime_catalog.description: A tiny girl discovered inside a bamboo stalk grows into a beautiful young woman desired by many suitors. This visually stunning film tells the classic Japanese folktale with breathtaking animation.
